entities.name: Query pyruvate dehydrogenase
observations: 573 aa soluble bacterial enzyme with TPP_enzyme_N, TPP_enzyme_M, and TPP_enzyme_C domains.
Shows 75.0% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed Escherichia coli pyruvate dehydrogenase [ubiquinone] P07003.
Strongly inferred to catalyze oxidative decarboxylation of pyruvate coupled to ubiquinone reduction, producing acetate and CO2.
Predicted cofactors are thiamine diphosphate, Mg2+ or Mn2+, and FAD by analogy to P07003.
Likely peripheral inner-membrane protein on the cytoplasmic side; localization is homology-based rather than directly experimentally established for the query.
Likely involved in pyruvate catabolism and respiratory-chain electron transfer to ubiquinone.

entities.name: P07003
observations: EC 1.2.5.1; catalyzes ubiquinone + pyruvate + H2O = ubiquinol + acetate + CO2.
Binds FAD, thiamine diphosphate, and Mg2+; Mn2+ can substitute for Mg2+.
Peripheral inner-membrane enzyme on the cytoplasmic side; homotetramer.
Associated with pyruvate catabolic process and ubiquinone-linked respiration.

entities.name: Pyruvate catabolism
observations: The query protein is strongly inferred to participate in pyruvate catabolism through oxidative decarboxylation to acetate and CO2.

entities.name: Ubiquinone-linked respiration
observations: The inferred enzyme transfers reducing equivalents from pyruvate-derived electrons to ubiquinone at the bacterial inner membrane.
